audit_items.proof_trace: The code sorts BlobSchedule in-place without synchronization (lines 707-709), mutating shared global config state. Concurrent calls can trigger data races where one thread reads partially-sorted data during iteration, returning incorrect blob limits.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker sends blocks via P2P that trigger concurrent MaxBlobsPerBlock calls during validation. Race condition causes validator to accept blocks with incorrect blob counts or reject valid blocks, disrupting consensus.
